verdict.detail: The album first came out in 1971 (UK).

notes.text:
Issued in a gimmick sleeve with a working zipper and with a printed insert with credits.

Marianne Faithfull is only credited as co-writer of B3 on the center label, not the insert. She wasn't credited at all on the early releases of this album.  

- On rear sleeve -
EMI Electrola GmbH, Köln
Printed in Germany by Druckhaus Maack KG, 5880 Lüdenscheid
A Rolling Stones Record
Made and Distributed by EMI Electrola

- On insert -
℗ 1971 Promotone B.V.
Rolling Stones Records. Distributed by EMI Records Ltd.

- On labels -
℗ 1971 Promotone B.V.
Made in Germany

Identical to

. The only difference is that this release was pressed by EMI and not by Sonopress. They used the same covers and labels for both pressings. It's most likely that both pressings were pressed simultaneously in both pressing plants.
